tasks.short: Judge feasibility of a software design.

steps.what: Read software requirements from the request.
Analyze user needs against those requirements.
Determine feasibility of the design.
Accept the feasibility of the design.
File the accepted feasibility note.

tasks.design: The developer reads requirement fields on {PROJECT} and still analyzes needs and determines feasibility within time and cost. They accept the note. {DOCS} files that version. Nothing decides feasibility.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feasibility was a fresh reading of notes, then a judgement, then a second copy of the same note.
tasks.enabler_now: The request can already store the need, the constraint, the time, and the cost as fields.
tasks.still_hard: Time and cost still have to be judged against a design that is not finished.
tasks.human_edge: The developer determines feasibility. A stored request does not.
tasks.altitude: The developer still analyzes needs and determines feasibility. Only the reading of stored requirement fields, and the filing of the note they accepted, move.

reach.task: Use a feasibility note the developer accepted
reach.learn: The note is a decision, not a draft to extend

evidence.claim: Feasibility within time and cost is a judgement. A stored requirements record can be read. It does not decide the design.
EU rules require literacy for a person who uses a system that drafts text or code. A user-facing bot must identify itself as a machine. This design has no bot.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a request is open and ends when the accepted feasibility note is on file. The developer determines feasibility.

The fields are the need, the constraint, the time, the cost, and their acceptance. The requester produces the need. The developer produces the decision. If those fields are blank, they read the request themselves.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps disagree: the analysis and the feasibility stay, and only the stored fields and the filing move.
unknowns: Whether the request already stores need, constraint, time, and cost.
Whether a manager must also accept the feasibility note.
research_questions: Does the request already store need, constraint, time, and cost?
Must a manager also accept the feasibility note?

tasks.short: Direct testing and file accepted programming.

steps.what: Run testing the pipeline already schedules.
Develop validation procedures for the change.
Draft testing programming from the procedures.

loop.purpose: Draft testing programming from the procedures the developer wrote.
loop.input: The procedure name, the step, and the expected result the developer wrote.
loop.output: A proposed test program that has not been written into the suite.
loop.check: The developer marks any test that adds a case they did not write.
loop.stop: Stop when the draft is marked ready or rejected. It never writes itself into the suite.
loop.why_not_simpler: A test program is code. Copying the procedure fields cannot write the program.

steps.what: Prepare testing documentation from the procedures.
Accept the testing programming.
Write the accepted testing programming.

tasks.design: The developer writes the validation procedures. A draft proposes testing programming only from those procedures, and {DOCS} fills documentation from the same fields. The developer accepts that version. {PROJECT} writes it. The scheduled run {WORKFLOW} already performs is not their labour.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedures, programming, and documentation were written by hand, and a run that already existed was easy to count as new saving.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can propose programming from procedure fields the developer already wrote, and the project record can fill a document from those same fields.
tasks.still_hard: The developer still has to invent the expected result. A draft must not add a case.
tasks.human_edge: The developer writes the procedures and accepts the programming. The draft does not.
tasks.altitude: The developer still writes procedures and accepts programming before it is written. The scheduled run is not treated as saved labour.

reach.learn: Do not treat a scheduled run as a new procedure

evidence.claim: An existing test pipeline that already runs on a schedule is not new human labour saved. A document can be filled from procedure fields the person wrote. The programming itself still needs a person to accept it.

A person who uses a system that drafts code must be able to accept or reject that draft. Generated code can contain defects, so a change is written only after the developer accepts that version. Product-security duties can apply when software is placed on the market. This design does not release software.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a change needs tests and ends when the accepted programming is written. The developer writes the procedures and accepts the programming. The scheduled run is excluded.

The fields are the procedure name, the step, the expected result, and their acceptance. The developer produces the expected result. The draft produces nothing that is written. If a draft adds a case, they reject it.
The prior classes this task as automate. The steps disagree: directing and the procedures stay, and the scheduled run is not saved human labour.
Zero new cases are allowed from the draft. The documentation step only copies fields.
unknowns: Whether a pipeline already runs this suite on a schedule.
Whether generated programming is allowed in that codebase.
research_questions: Does a pipeline already run this suite on a schedule?
Is generated programming allowed in that codebase?

tasks.short: Confer on design limitations and interfaces.

steps.what: Confer with systems analysts on the design.
Confer with engineers on project limitations.
Write the interfaces they obtain.
Accept the interfaces information.
File the accepted interfaces information.

tasks.design: The conferences stay in the room. The developer writes the interfaces they obtained and accepts that note. {DOCS} files that version. The conferences are not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value was the conference. The note was then typed again into the project file.
tasks.enabler_now: A file can store a note the developer has already written and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: Limitations and performance requirements are still said in the room, not in a form.
tasks.human_edge: The developer confers and writes what was obtained. A file does not confer.
tasks.altitude: The conferences stay in full. Only filing the interfaces note they accepted is shorter.

reach.learn: The conference is not replaced by the note

evidence.claim: A design conference is the work. Filing a note the person already wrote does not replace the conference.

EU data-protection rules limit monitoring of staff to what is necessary and proportionate. National rules on employee monitoring differ. This design does not score a developer and does not record a supervision conversation.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the conference is held and ends when the accepted interfaces note is on file. The developer confers, then writes the note.
The fields are the interface name and their acceptance. The people in the room produce the information. The developer writes it. If the conference did not name an interface, nothing is filed.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the conferences stay. They file only the note.
unknowns: Whether programmers attend the same conference or a later one.
Whether the interfaces note is allowed to leave the project file.
research_questions: Do programmers attend the same conference or a later one?
May the interfaces note leave the project file?

tasks.short: Modify software and write the accepted change.

steps.what: Read software errors from the defect record.
Decide how to modify the software.
Draft the software change for those errors.

loop.purpose: Draft a software change from the decision the developer made.
loop.input: The defect record and the modification decision.
loop.output: A proposed change that has not been written.
loop.check: The developer marks any change that goes beyond the decision.
loop.stop: Stop when the draft is marked ready or rejected. It never writes itself.
loop.why_not_simpler: The change is code. A copy of the defect record cannot write the change.

steps.what: Check performance of the software change.
Accept the software change.
Write the accepted software change.

tasks.design: The developer reads the defect on {PROJECT}, decides the modification, and checks performance of the draft on the bench. A draft may propose the change. They accept it only after that check. {PROJECT} writes that version. Nothing adapts hardware on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: The defect, the edit, and the performance check were one sitting, and a bad edit was easy to merge.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can propose a change from a decision the developer already wrote, after the defect fields are on the record.
tasks.still_hard: Hardware limits and performance still have to be checked by the developer before the change is written.
tasks.human_edge: The developer decides the modification and accepts it after the performance check.
tasks.altitude: The developer still decides the modification and checks performance before accepting the change. The write stores only that version.

reach.task: Supply the hardware limit the developer asked for
reach.learn: The developer still decides how the software adapts

evidence.claim: A stored defect can be opened. The decision to modify software, and the performance check, stay with the person who will accept the change.

A person who uses a system that drafts code must be able to accept or reject that draft. Generated code can contain defects, so a change is written only after the developer accepts that version. Product-security duties can apply when software is placed on the market. This design does not release software.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a defect is open and ends when the accepted change is written. The performance check happens before acceptance. The developer decides the modification.

The fields are the defect, the decision, the performance note, and their acceptance. The reporter produces the defect. The developer produces the decision. If the draft goes beyond the decision, they reject it.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps disagree on the decision and the performance check, which stay.
unknowns: Whether the bench check can be done on the target hardware.
Whether a second person must accept a change that touches hardware.
research_questions: Can the bench check be done on the target hardware?
Must a second person accept a change that touches hardware?

role.altitude: The developer still determines feasibility, still confers in the room, and still decides how to modify software after a performance check. A requirements read, a procedure-based draft, and a file of a note they accepted are the parts that move. A scheduled test run is not counted as their labour.
reach: A systems analyst uses a feasibility note the developer accepted
A tester runs programming the developer accepted
skills_to_grow: Determining feasibility rather than having a draft decide it
Writing validation procedures rather than having a draft invent cases
Accepting a software change only after the performance check
role.ambitious_version: Every feasibility note, every test program, and every software change that is written is one the developer accepted.
